message:
monday is actually a great night to be in [canggu](kebi://area/id/bali/canggu), and your saves line up perfectly with it. here's how i'd play it:

start at [Luigi's](kebi://venue/c59914af-38a0-499e-8d5a-b3416eb2ed3e). monday is literally their night, that's when they do their house and techno DJ set, pizza plus a proper dancefloor energy, and it's 7:30 now so the room is just starting to build. that's the anchor for tonight.

from there, walk over to [Old Man's](kebi://venue/45a09352-bfd6-403a-b5c5-7b23699a1ce2) on batu bolong. it runs every single day, classic beach bar backpacker energy, good spot for a drink between moves and to let the night breathe a bit.

then end at [Sand Bar](kebi://venue/f01f4435-631c-41e9-a3a9-f05356eb82c2), also right there on batu bolong. they do afterparties every night, so it's the natural late move when Luigi's winds down.

skip for tonight:
- [Vault](kebi://venue/7861b346-2a73-4a7a-a66c-b58840527758) is wednesday to saturday only, not tonight
- [The Mesa](kebi://venue/968ba4ad-fc09-4365-8d69-dac6358c1722) is a friday spot
- [Motel Mexicola](kebi://venue/8099938c-7730-4890-93e1-bd333d3a8ffa) is in your saves but tuesday is their big night, you're one day early
- [La Favela](kebi://venue/c00a6f5c-20d4-4955-924b-41a38a3fc9d8) is over in seminyak, not worth the ride when your monday is this sorted in canggu
- [Da Maria](kebi://venue/4444bc95-be3c-4b2e-9eb8-2c2f226adae8) is their wednesday R&B night, two days out

luigi's then old man's then sand bar, your monday is set.
